OUR APPROACH
FLAWLESSLY EXECUTED and HYPER-PERSONALIZED
We combine science-driven techniques with a luxury experience to craft treatment plans tailored to your individual skin goals
SIGNATURE SERVICES
The Comstock Facial
Our signature facial is a fully customized treatment designed to deeply cleanse, restore hydration, and enhance your skin's natural glow. Each treatment is tailored using medical-grade skincare and advanced techniques to support healthy, radiant skin.
BOOK NOW
Sofwave Skin Tightening
Advanced ultrasound treatment that stimulates collagen production to lift, tighten, and improve skin elasticity. With little to no downtime, it helps restore a firmer, more youthful appearance over time.
BOOK NOW
Injectable Rejuvenation
Injectable treatments restore balance and youthful contours using neuromodulators, dermal fillers, skin boosters, and Sculptra. Our approach focuses on subtle, natural-looking results that enhance your features while preserving your unique beauty.
BOOK NOW
BBL + Moxi Laser
BBL and Moxi work together to improve tone, texture, and overall skin quality. This powerful laser combination targets sun damage, pigmentation, and early signs of aging while stimulating healthy skin renewal.
BOOK NOW
TREATMENTS TAILORED to YOU
We offer comprehensive skincare here at The Comstock, offering a combination approach to help you reach a wide variety of skin goals; we create treatment plans customized to fit YOU.

01
FACIALS +
SKIN REJUVENATION

Our facials and rejuvenating treatments are designed to restore balance, hydration, and radiance while supporting long-term skin health. Using advanced medical-grade products and innovative techniques, each experience is customized to your skin’s unique needs—revealing a smoother, brighter, and more glowing complexion with every visit.

A FEW FAVORITES
The Jamie Glow Combo
COLLAGEN STIMULATION, BRIGHTENING TIGHTENING, HYDRATION
Exclusive 3-in-1 glow treatment featuring Hydrafacial, BBL, and PRX. The ultimate combo for brighter, firmer, healthier looking skin.
The Comstock Hydrafacial

DEEP CLEANSING, HYDRATION, CHEMICAL EXFOLIATION, BRIGHTENING

Our signature Hydrafacial deeply cleanses and hydrates with targeted boosters, plus lymphatic drainage, LED, Gua Sha, and your choice of dermaplane or jelly mask.
